Filters combine collection, author, publisher, language, condition, reading status, location, shelf, type, year, loans, favourites, page count, loan dates, subjects and colours. Selecting a title opens its record. Within a collection, the notes and images counters filter that collection only; selecting the counter again clears the filter. With images counts books containing images in their notes. Each book counts once, regardless of its image count. Covers are excluded.
Le bouton « Sauvegarder » télécharge un: Back up downloads a complete file containing books, notes, images and colour labels. The file can be saved in Files on iPad or in a folder of your choice. Back up collection, near the title, exports only the current collection with its images. Restoring a collection preserves other collections.

Apply saves the choice, Cancel restores the last saved choice and Reset colours restores defaults. Colours are saved on this device and included in full backups. « Ajouter un livre » crée une fiche. « D: Add a book creates a record. Duplicate opens an independent copy with its fields, notes and images, ready to edit before saving. Edit allows notes and images to be added. Save record keeps the changes. Full record PDF and Notes PDF export the saved content. Notes PDF includes attached images, without the cover or metadata. Page count and language are available fields. In notes, selecting text then choosing Apply text colour or Highlight applies the selected colour; Preview shows the result. Images can serve as covers or appear in notes. Lent to and Loan date record the borrower and date. Clearing both fields marks the book as returned.
« Sélectionner » affiche les cases dans: Select shows checkboxes in Table and Cover views. In this mode, tapping a book selects it without opening its record. In Cover view, dragging selects a range of books; starting on a selected book deselects the range. The screen edge scrolls during the gesture. Gaps between cards allow normal scrolling. All results selects books matching the filters across every page. Edit selection opens a dialog where only checked fields are replaced. An empty value clears a checked field. Loans can also be edited in bulk. Titles, numbers, ISBNs, covers, notes and attached images stay unchanged. Duplicate creates one copy of every selected book and selects the copies. Undo reverts the group in one action.
